Golden fixture

This file exercises every element the allowlist permits and every control the sanitizer exists for. It is rendered by TestTheGoldenFileMatches, which fails when the output changes — so a change to an extension, to the policy, or to the escaping has to be an intentional update here and a bump to markdown.Version, which is what actually invalidates a deployed cache.

Text and emphasis

Plain prose with an ampersand: Tom & Jerry. Text with angle brackets: <not-a-tag>. Italic, bold, both, struck through, and an inline code span.

A soft break, and a hard break after this line.

Raw HTML, which is escaped rather than executed

A script block:

<script>alert('this must never execute')</script>

An inline handler: <img src="x" onerror="alert('neither must this')">

An iframe: <iframe src="https://evil.example"></iframe>

A comment: <!-- which must not survive -->

An SVG script: <svg><script>alert('nor this')</script></svg>

An event handler on a div: <div onclick="alert('nor this')">click</div>
